question: The marked price of a wet grinder is ₹6,500. It was sold at two successive discounts of 5% and 4%. Find its selling price.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount % = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100

Net discount = 5 + 4 − (5 × 4) ÷ 100 = 9 − 0.2 = 8.8%

Selling Price = MP × (100 − Net Discount%) ÷ 100

SP = 6500 × (100 − 8.8) ÷ 100 = 6500 × 91.2 ÷ 100 = 65 × 91.2 = 5928

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,928.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marked Price (MP) = ₹6,500, First Discount (d₁) = 5%, Second Discount (d₂) = 4%.
**Formula:** SP = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/010a21834ff466dee8b9f157fde490fc87451300833923ed58efcc0b6b39f3bb.png] 
⇒ Price after 1st discount = 6500 × (95/100) = 65 × 95 = ₹6,175
⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 6175 × (96/100)
⇒ SP = 61.75 × 96
⇒ SP = ₹5,928

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,928.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP − Discount.

Successive Discounts

When multiple discounts are applied one after another, the second discount is applied to the **reduced price** after the first discount.
